analysis: The PR changes only docs/developer/test.md. It adds a 'Provider authorization guidance' section (head lines 17-28) that documents running ProviderAuthorizationReadinessTests via `swift test --skip-build --no-parallel --filter ...`. This is documentation only: no source, key handling, protocol, or runtime behavior changes, so no new attack surface or regression against the threat model (TB-011, T-052/T-053/T-057, A-016) is visible. The described tests use fixed snapshots and injected process identity, make no live Apple/coordinator calls, and the text explicitly disclaims native App Attest acceptance, so it does not overclaim trust (consistent with T-056/T-058). The rest of the file (base lines 1-939 visible) is unchanged context, including SSD test-directory guidance (DARKBLOOM_SSD_TEST_TMPDIR, which rejects symlink, relative, and missing paths and does not touch the production cache, so T-041 is unaffected), add-on hold tests (TB-012/T-059/T-060), and endpoint resumption/logout tests (T-053). I did not verify that ProviderAuthorizationReadinessTests exists or that its semantics (late-but-unexpired lease visibility, removal advice gated on a fresh matching decision) match the source. That implementation is outside the supplied evidence and is a possible follow-up for a source-side review. The patch excerpt is complete and the range map is complete.
